PositionalEmbedding: Original class is contained in layers/Embed.py; there is no separate required positional source file.
loading: Only AST class/function definitions execute; author imports, training scripts and global layers package never execute.
core_preservation: Original batch/channel mean FFT frequency selection; no per-sample substitution.
Original 2D Inception aggregation, residual, and shared LayerNorm after each TimesBlock.
Original DataEmbedding classification input path with x_mark=None and circular TokenEmbedding padding.
adapter: Two independent backbones at native dynamic length100/channels8 and state length60/channels26.
Unused author flattened classification projection and temporal embedding are removed.
Original classification GELU/dropout and padding mask precede learned d_model-to64 plus LayerNorm sequence projection.
Same clean_inputs and full/terminal masked pooling; common346->128->7; allmissing TRAIN prior.
batch_dependence: FFT_for_Period aggregates abs(rfft(x)) across batch and channels. Train and eval batch size, sample order and grouping must be recorded by the runner; changing them can alter outputs.
capacity_choice: Data-free pre-training decision; d_model16/d_ff32 used by original official classification script; no validation-performance sweep.
fast_convolutions: Existing helper is applied only to zero-padding Conv1d modules. Official circular TokenEmbedding Conv1d is kept unchanged.
